content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe and PayPal are conventional giants in the payment processing space, providing a user-friendly interface and integration options for digital sellers. However, their reach is limited, excluding vast markets due to compliance and regulatory issues. This leaves creators in restricted countries with few options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH enables creators to build and operate their own online stores without the need for a centralized payment processor. This approach ensures that creators have full ownership of their products and data, sidestepping the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's limitations are glaring, as it operates in just 46 countries, leaving many creators unable to use their services. PayPal can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, creating further uncertainty for creators. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators in restricted countries to utilize cryptocurrency for payments, circumventing the need for conventional banking systems. By using tools like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring a reliable and immediate payment process regardless of their geographical restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal typically impose fees that can accumulate quickly, along with delayed payment processing times that can hinder cash flow. Payment processing can take days or even weeks, which is detrimental for digital creators needing quick access to funds. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, operates on a different model. With a minimal fee of 0.5% through NOWPayments and instant payment confirmations on-chain, creators experience a far more efficient system. The low transaction costs associated with networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON also enhance profitability.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales process.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A critical drawback of conventional payment processors is that they maintain control over transactions and data, which can limit a creator's ability to adapt or pivot. For example, if an account is suspended, access to funds and sales data can be compromised. Sovereign commerce infrastructure prioritizes creator ownership, allowing them to control their entire sales process. After deployment, creators own their stack outright, with no ongoing fees or subscriptions. This autonomy extends to automation features that streamline product delivery through platforms like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that creators can deliver products seamlessly.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are in a restricted country, the sovereign commerce stack is your best option, providing a comprehensive solution without the limitations of mainstream platforms. For those who need a straightforward setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a quick deployment for up to three products. Alternatively, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a more robust solution with additional features for those looking to scale. Ultimately, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack efficiently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as 0.5%.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
